findings.description: The caption states 2 leaves of 0.381 x 2.032 x 0.006 m in mirror_bypass and a total of 11.8 kg. The stated area density is 15.0 kg/m2, so those leaves weigh 23 kg between them: the slab mass has been computed for one leaf and then split across all 2. Every leaf is 2x too light.
